unsupported: Southwest Prototyping operates from Albuquerque, New Mexico, providing engineering and fabrication services to industrial and research clients.
The company maintains a CAGE code (6FB48) for government contracting, though its founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

On the electronics side, the team designs, assembles, and tests printed circuit boards, develops firmware for microcontrollers (Atmel, SiLabs, Microchip, ARM), and writes application software for Windows, Linux, and real-time platforms such as National Instruments LabVIEW.

Known for: In-house mechanical, electrical, and software engineering combined with fabrication; Rapid prototyping and design-for-manufacturability support; COTS product alteration and ruggedized electronics packaging; CAGE code 6FB48 for government and defense contracting
